item.title: Best Class in 99 Nights in the Forest — Tier List (Community)
item.description: There is no single “best class” — but there is a best class for your situation. This tier list ranks the 10 classes by how much they contribute to a typical squad run, with notes for solo play. ⚠ Opinion, not gospel: This is a community opinion ranking based on the current class roles. Balance patches can move classes between tiers — the reasoning below matters more than the letter. Tier list S — Meta picks Medic — healing and revives are the difference between a wipe and a recovery.
